label: Strong ordered variant and recipient willing exclude non-rational caused effects
description: Analyst formulation. At ONE RecipientGoodWilling W (the bridge instantiated at W.WillsGoodFor): for a distinct, non-rational, actual x whose esse a GOD_4 with will causes, a94c5dfc gives that g wills x's good to x, and the strong variant denies it. Hence such an x cannot exist if both hold. The two statements are therefore jointly incompatible with the creation of any non-rational being; this does not say which to reject. The weak ordered reading has no such conflict.
